text:
Zara (People Ops): Quick idea  let's run a small "Ripple Rewards" drop next Thursday 2:30pm in the atrium — quick sticky-note shoutouts + tiny enamel ripple pins. Low-key, 20-30 min. :sparkles:
Tom (HR): Sounds nice. Policy Q: if a manager later requests a cash spot-award tied to a nomination, what's our handoff?
Zara (People Ops): Plan is swag-first. If cash conversion is requested, manager files the spot-award form and includes the original nomination ID. We'll keep a CSV for audit.
Chris - Eng: How will nominations work? Open peer-noms or on-site only?
Zara (People Ops): Both. Open form for 72hrs + sticky notes on-site. Form fields: nominee, one-line reason (max 120 chars), optional anonymity.
Maya - Sales: For remote folks, can we mail a pin or send a small e-gift? International shipping can be rough.
Olive (Facilities): Recommend digital badge + $5 e-gift if shipping > $8. I can run shipping estimates by Monday.
Tom (HR): Also will confirm tax/treatment for mailed swag vs cash. I'll post a short guide and the spot-award link by EOD Mon.
kudos-bot: Auto: "Nomination received: Chris nominated Priya for fixing the staging deploy blocker! :tada:"
Chris - Eng: Nice. Logistics: volunteers for setup/pack/takedown?
Zara (People Ops): Volunteer shifts: pack kits Tue 4-5pm (1-2 ppl), setup Thu 2:00-2:25 (2 ppl), host 2:25-3:00 (2 ppl), teardown 3:00-3:10 (1 person). Who's in?
Maya - Sales: I can host 2:25-3:00 and help with remote address checks.
Chris - Eng: I can do teardown and help pack Tue.
Olive (Facilities): I'll reserve the atrium table and order pins + sticker sheets. Need final counts by Mon 11am.
Zara (People Ops): I'll draft announcement copy tonight. Draft blurb: "Nominate a teammate for a Ripple Reward — share a quick example of how they helped or made your day. Nominations open 72hrs. We'll celebrate Thursday 2:30pm with pins & shoutouts. Remote folks: select 'mail kit' on the form or choose a digital badge." Thoughts?
Tom (HR): Wording looks good. Add a line about how to convert to a spot-award: "Managers: to convert, submit the spot-award form and include the nomination ID." Keeps it transparent.
Maya - Sales: Can we get a small mic pass (3 quick rounds) so it doesn't run long?
Zara (People Ops): Yes — will do 3 mic passes by org (eng, product, ops) to keep it snappy. We'll publish the nominee list at noon Thu.
kudos-bot: Auto: "Nomination: Maya nominated Lina for last-minute demo help! :sparkles:"
Chris - Eng: One ask: include a short example sentence in the announcement people can copy into the form. Helps reduce friction.
Zara (People Ops): Good call. I'll include example: "Helped unblock deploy by pairing on a fix yesterday."
Olive (Facilities): Final note: catering not needed, but I'll have extra chairs and a small sign. Please confirm final kit total by Mon 11am.
Zara (People Ops): Thanks all — action items: Zara publish form + calendar invite by Tue, Olive confirm shipping & order pins by Mon 11am, Tom post spot-award conversion guide by Mon EOD, volunteers: Chris (pack + teardown), Maya (host). I'll ping again tomorrow.
notes: Ripple Rewards pop-up; 72hr open nominations; swag-first with spot-award conversion workflow; volunteer shifts; remote kit option; HR to confirm tax/compliance
